cards.cue: Hook — grab the room in 15 seconds
cards.line: Raise your hand if you have checked your phone in the last five minutes. Now keep it up if it was in the last thirty seconds.
cards.note: Pause. Scan the room. Let the hands drop on their own.

cards.cue: Name the stakes — why should they care?
cards.line: We are not short on information. We are short on attention — and it is the one resource we can never manufacture more of.
cards.note: Slow down. Land “never” with a beat of silence.

cards.cue: The one idea they must remember
cards.line: Protect attention like a budget: decide what it is worth before the notifications decide for you.
cards.note: This is the quotable line. Say it, then repeat it.

cards.cue: Call to action — what do they do Monday?
cards.line: Tonight, turn off one notification. Just one. Tomorrow you will feel the quiet, and you will want more of it.
cards.note: Warm tone. End on eye contact, not the slide.
